rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a shout or cry.

example.english: A yell suddenly came from next door and startled me.
example.traditional: 隔籬突然傳嚟一聲叫聲，嚇咗我一跳。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 dat6 jin4 cyun4 lai4 jat1 seng1 giu3 seng1 haak3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 tiu3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for shouting loudly, especially in anger or excitement.

example.english: Everyone started to yell in the final minute.
example.traditional: 最後一分鐘，大家都大嗌。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 daai6 aai3

rows.note: Use this when the yelling is directed at someone as a rebuke or scolding.

example.english: The boss likes to yell at people in front of everyone.
example.traditional: 個老闆成日喺人哋面前嗌人。
example.jyutping: go3 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 aai3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when information such as directions is conveyed by shouting rather than simply describing a loud outburst.

example.english: I had to yell up from downstairs for you to come eat.
example.traditional: 我喺樓下嗌你落嚟食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 lau4 haa6 aai3 nei5 lok6 lai4 sik6 faan6
